meta.name: troy_horse
meta.prompt: The Trojan horse in Troy, right before the soldiers emerge from the horse.

programs.brief: A monumental wooden Trojan horse stands at the gate: full-bodied with four timber legs, a hollow belly, a concealed closed hatch and a small internal stair, poised for soldiers to emerge but showing no soldiers yet. Use the settlement's own api.theme wood, stone and ground roles so it belongs to Troy; only weathered timber and rope may be icon-specific, and publish a primary way-in anchor named door.

A compact line of two or three ancient warships lies beached along the sandy Aegean shore, with tilted hulls, oars, raised and broken masts, ropes and dragged-up keels. Use the settlement's own api.theme for the shore works and structure, with weathered timber, rope and sail cloth as the icon-specific materials.

tokens.terrain: a walled city on a rise above a sandy Aegean coast, with the sea and ships in view
tokens.icons: the wooden Trojan horse at the gates; massive city walls with towers; beached warships along the shore; a citadel-palace above the flat-roofed town
tokens.timing: the moment before the soldiers emerge from the horse
